structuredContent.content:
name: R5 trim-realization-conditioned certificates

on:
  push:
    branches: ['evidence/full-sprint-20261028-r5']
    paths:
      - 'engineering/engineering-followup-20261028-r5/compute/RUN_REQUEST.json'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: r5-exterior-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  exact-certificates:
    if: github.repository == 'TrillionniumFoundation/RAZR-SLIDE' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/evidence/full-sprint-20261028-r5'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 55
    steps:
      - name: Check out this exact evidence source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            engineering/engineering-followup-20261027-r4/envelope
            engineering/engineering-followup-20261028-r5/compute
      - name: Verify reviewed source lock and execute sequential original gates
        env:
          EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"
          python3 -I -S -B - <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          from pathlib import Path
          p = Path('engineering/engineering-followup-20261028-r5/compute/R5E_PORTABLE_SOURCE_LOCK_V5.json')
          assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'd05a6f6a69ac5eb627d3d1180ff543c4f9b70c7c424c972dfab2b305b8a21211'
          PY
          python3 -I -S -B engineering/engineering-followup-20261028-r5/compute/run_portable_trim_r5e_v5.py \
            --r4-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/engineering/engineering-followup-20261027-r4/envelope" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/razr-r5-trim-model-v5"
      - name: Preserve complete actual outputs including failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
        with:
          name: R5-trim-model-v5-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/razr-r5-trim-model-v5
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
